_comment: Add a new case by placing files in the sample directories and appending
one object to the 'cases' array.  No code changes required.
Threshold keys (all optional — missing keys fall back to 'defaults'):
min_layout_score          float  overall composite layout score floor
min_topology_preservation float  topology preservation score floor
min_section_placement     float  section placement score floor
min_section_coherence     float  overall section coherence floor
max_high_stress_sections  int    maximum number of sections with stress_level='high'

cases.notes: Personal two-column template; sidebar left; known stale-token overlap.

NBSP/tab-column role header template. The LLM output for this fixture only provides one pipe-separated role header; the experience section is shorter than the 4-role template, shifting education's page position. Threshold lowered from 0.80 after fixing NBSP/tab-column role detection (template 4 experience now correctly updated).
Section placement weaker due to template section-name variations.
